items.markdown:
**Asian flush** (also known as **Asian glow** or the **alcohol flush reaction** ) is a condition where a person develops blotchy redness on their face, neck, shoulders, or body after drinking alcohol. It affects roughly 30% to 50% of East Asians and around 560 million people worldwide.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESiwEBxCJF11KWhnSnXYITsbD_Y1gkoPpfFdbfHQv1eg-J3YadZW10smCKJBRg8m2vbzfSYVnn3g6A_ovkeqvASn5pXx64pWAvFmVPy-VN_3ebX7WC3ShExAUnX623z_ARokcwLq7eEGvEtqeMs9p9pBeg-HlI-E9quHWXIPf6ueafp3b2hNImwkZbazHu)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEShgEBxCJF14xdAncrDo6TocLf4s1AuRGRjrDEOAbIQvLqJ5dMJmner8nQVFo1mfJeXVR5vcYfJI2krjV3gUVEh1DunbN2QjRyLYZwF6_mmjYNnQAGfAqk9AX8SCDUuuu96CGw2K-8H4VVs-yCrSOBr2AUepyToAcryKiAIZ8jQtVSEmwIbybNQw)

### Why It Happens

- **Enzyme deficiency:** The body breaks alcohol down into **acetaldehyde** , a toxic compound, before converting it into harmless acetate.[[1]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=G6717bNakuA&t=1)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESiwEBxCJF11KWhnSnXYITsbD_Y1gkoPpfFdbfHQv1eg-J3YadZW10smCKJBRg8m2vbzfSYVnn3g6A_ovkeqvASn5pXx64pWAvFmVPy-VN_3ebX7WC3ShExAUnX623z_ARokcwLq7eEGvEtqeMs9p9pBeg-HlI-E9quHWXIPf6ueafp3b2hNImwkZbazHu)
- **Genetic variation:** Many people with this reaction have a variation in the **ALDH2** gene that makes the enzyme responsible for clearing acetaldehyde less efficient or inactive.[[1]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=G6717bNakuA&t=1)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESiwEBxCJF11KWhnSnXYITsbD_Y1gkoPpfFdbfHQv1eg-J3YadZW10smCKJBRg8m2vbzfSYVnn3g6A_ovkeqvASn5pXx64pWAvFmVPy-VN_3ebX7WC3ShExAUnX623z_ARokcwLq7eEGvEtqeMs9p9pBeg-HlI-E9quHWXIPf6ueafp3b2hNImwkZbazHu)
- **Toxin buildup:** Acetaldehyde accumulates in the body, dilating blood vessels and triggering symptoms like skin redness, warmth, a rapid heart rate, nausea, headaches, or dizziness.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESewHEIkXXBI0jTqZorGvrZR5hqEIJxF2G28mR571wdrLG8GnBiF_IjdxFs-aElfG7sQwgBQgvoPYuYUNJXbwLTWaCfHpGtdcn0vMM9vNRu40FqubhTZPMtkSKY9zyBabKzS8P5Rol_MK_X8ncco7gK9FsR8hHTt3obPCI9g)[[2]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=G6717bNakuA&t=1)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEShgEBxCJF14xdAncrDo6TocLf4s1AuRGRjrDEOAbIQvLqJ5dMJmner8nQVFo1mfJeXVR5vcYfJI2krjV3gUVEh1DunbN2QjRyLYZwF6_mmjYNnQAGfAqk9AX8SCDUuuu96CGw2K-8H4VVs-yCrSOBr2AUepyToAcryKiAIZ8jQtVSEmwIbybNQw)

### Health Risks and Myths

- **Cancer risk:** Because acetaldehyde is a carcinogen, frequent alcohol consumption with an ALDH2 deficiency raises the risk of certain cancers, particularly **esophageal cancer**.[[1]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=v7jbCZ0peY8&t=27)[[2]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=G6717bNakuA&t=1)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESrAEBxCJF1_NqpXqqBWqu8UCOpQamk5Slrq3DGZPFfD7xofYahJjfFsh6TPaLw4UOERGpCUapC8WuSi2oXtEzuOeCu9ISCO_6MZD5MO199_fEj3i1dapBfRMdBHnbmZysdFUz3FVVs0l1OUJ0__B_lAfvMhWZFa1tjtCqC9Kzw0MZYSlkSV-OFNdiI9pGzmga1-e8d7UnTTUbk5xT87OU3vDoJ0qSKzjp5TAhu6Oq)
- **Antihistamines don't protect you:** Medications like Pepcid or other antihistamines may reduce visible redness or itching, but they do not stop acetaldehyde from building up in your tissues.[[1]](https://www.instagram.com/reel/C8Sf35xosLq/?hl=en)[[2]](https://www.instagram.com/reel/DXHmwMWkWVN/?hl=en)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESfAHEIkXXKrMfbjVhDsVJNafqfbXLThz5fKgwMUINEH67idkuS-XkdqN4iaSqA5DNjF4-StQZfyhXMsUyTonwqKpjMRTB7mK2SMxYF8tZFhZ5rrYWs0ps9RP1hOCHessTH5Big8WUtJIUZbRIOaTb_iD5brlT_qRuhYFWF_4)
- **Most effective prevention:** Limiting or avoiding alcohol is the clearest way to prevent acetaldehyde buildup and its associated health risks.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEShgEBxCJF14xdAncrDo6TocLf4s1AuRGRjrDEOAbIQvLqJ5dMJmner8nQVFo1mfJeXVR5vcYfJI2krjV3gUVEh1DunbN2QjRyLYZwF6_mmjYNnQAGfAqk9AX8SCDUuuu96CGw2K-8H4VVs-yCrSOBr2AUepyToAcryKiAIZ8jQtVSEmwIbybNQw)[[2]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=v7jbCZ0peY8&t=27)

For more details on the genetics and biology behind the reaction, see [Stanford Medicine](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESiwEBxCJF11KWhnSnXYITsbD_Y1gkoPpfFdbfHQv1eg-J3YadZW10smCKJBRg8m2vbzfSYVnn3g6A_ovkeqvASn5pXx64pWAvFmVPy-VN_3ebX7WC3ShExAUnX623z_ARokcwLq7eEGvEtqeMs9p9pBeg-HlI-E9quHWXIPf6ueafp3b2hNImwkZbazHu) or read [Hyphen Magazine](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESfAHEIkXXKrMfbjVhDsVJNafqfbXLThz5fKgwMUINEH67idkuS-XkdqN4iaSqA5DNjF4-StQZfyhXMsUyTonwqKpjMRTB7mK2SMxYF8tZFhZ5rrYWs0ps9RP1hOCHessTH5Big8WUtJIUZbRIOaTb_iD5brlT_qRuhYFWF_4).[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESiwEBxCJF11KWhnSnXYITsbD_Y1gkoPpfFdbfHQv1eg-J3YadZW10smCKJBRg8m2vbzfSYVnn3g6A_ovkeqvASn5pXx64pWAvFmVPy-VN_3ebX7WC3ShExAUnX623z_ARokcwLq7eEGvEtqeMs9p9pBeg-HlI-E9quHWXIPf6ueafp3b2hNImwkZbazHu)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESfAHEIkXXKrMfbjVhDsVJNafqfbXLThz5fKgwMUINEH67idkuS-XkdqN4iaSqA5DNjF4-StQZfyhXMsUyTonwqKpjMRTB7mK2SMxYF8tZFhZ5rrYWs0ps9RP1hOCHessTH5Big8WUtJIUZbRIOaTb_iD5brlT_qRuhYFWF_4)
